connector.name: IntakeQ MCP
connector.registryDescription: IntakeQ/PracticeQ MCP connector with HIPAA §164.312(b) audit logging on every PHI read/write
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package intakeq-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oktopeak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INTAKEQ_API_KEY
env.description: IntakeQ API key (optional — prefer the set_api_key tool)

env.name: INTAKEQ_API_BASE
env.description: Override the default IntakeQ API base URL (https://intakeq.com/api/v1)

env.name: MCP_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token gate on the HTTP /mcp endpoint. Required in http mode unless MCP_ALLOW_NO_AUTH is true

env.name: MCP_ALLOW_NO_AUTH
env.description: Set to true to allow HTTP mode without MCP_API_KEY (local development only)

env.name: MCP_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for HTTP transport (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000)

env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP listen port (default 3000). HTTP transport only.
